summary: Open-PR cap counts re-entering task PRs: #2496 and #2508 held two of three slots for most of 2026-11-07 while 17 tasks queued; DEC-0373 set the limit to executors.max with repairs exempt from claiming but not from the count. Should a task PR in an executor round (reenter in flight or inflight claim) stop counting against the open-PR limit, or should the limit be raised?

options.description: openTaskPrs() skips a task PR whose task has a live inflight claim or a queued reenter manifest; the limit stays executors.max (3). Recommended: the cap was meant to bound unreviewed delivered PRs, and a PR being reworked is not one.
Set executors.openPrLimit to 5 in .ai-sdlc/dispatch/config.json; counting unchanged.
Keep DEC-0373 as is; accept the slot loss while re-entry loops run.
